title.narrative: Technical Assistance to the Government of Curacao

description.narrative: The Ministry of Traffic Transport and Urban Planning (MTTUP) of the Government of Curacao has requested the assistance of UNOPS to undertake an assessment of several aspects of the road infrastructure network resilience. UNOPS assists the Government of Curacao in its objective of adapting Its management of infrastructures in a way that will be resilient to the different changes that the country will face in the coming future, from the effects of climate change to an economy that is less reliant on fossil fuels. The overall outcome is expected to support decision makers in the allocation of resources in a strategic and optimized manner. The technical aspects of the ministries portfolio, as well as organizational aspects, ensuring that resilience principles are embedded in each activity, leading to a holistic understanding of what is required on the short, medium and long term and what best strategy to use. \n \n
